name: theguardian
description: The Guardian (theguardian.com) news site. The CLI reads articles, edition and section fronts, tag and topic listings, writer pages, most-read lists, daily section archives, topic and contributor indexes, and reader comments as JSON. It uses the site's own `.json?dcr` page data, RSS feeds and the public discussion API.

commands.name: get-article
commands.summary: Get one full article (headline, standfirst, byline, date, body blocks, tags) as JSON from its URL parts

params.name: section
params.description: First path segment of the article URL, e.g. world, us-news, sport, commentisfree

params.name: year
params.description: 4-digit year from the article URL

params.name: month
params.description: 3-letter lowercase month from the article URL

params.name: day
params.description: 2-digit day from the article URL

params.name: slug
params.description: Article slug, the last URL segment

commands.name: get-front
commands.summary: Get an edition or section front page (e.g. international, uk, us, sport) as its list of curated story collections

params.name: front
params.description: Front path: an edition (international, uk, us, au) or a section (sport, culture, world, business). Section fronts may redirect to an edition-specific version (sport -> us/sport).

commands.name: get-tag-feed
commands.summary: Get the RSS feed of the latest articles for a tag or topic, with title, link, date, byline and categories

params.name: section
params.description: Part of the tag id before the slash, e.g. world, society, science

params.name: tag
params.description: Part of the tag id after the slash, e.g. italy

commands.name: list-contributor-articles
commands.summary: Get the RSS feed of a Guardian writer's latest articles (e.g. angela-giuffrida), with title, link, date, byline and categories

params.name: slug
params.description: Contributor profile slug, e.g. angela-giuffrida (the profile/<slug> tag id)

commands.name: get-most-read
commands.summary: Get the site-wide most-viewed and deeply-read article lists with headline, url, byline and shortUrl

commands.name: list-section-day
commands.summary: List all articles published in a section on one date (daily archive, e.g. world on 2026/oct/17)

params.name: section
params.description: Section id, e.g. world, us-news, sport, business

params.name: year
params.description: 4-digit year

params.name: month
params.description: 3-letter lowercase month

params.name: day
params.description: 2-digit day

commands.name: list-subjects
commands.summary: Browse the A-Z index of Guardian topics/subjects for one letter; links give tag ids

params.name: letter
params.description: Single lowercase letter a-z

commands.name: list-contributors
commands.summary: Browse the A-Z index of Guardian writers/contributors for one letter; links give profile slugs

params.name: letter
params.description: Single lowercase letter a-z (surname initial)

commands.name: list-comments
commands.summary: List reader comments on an article by its short id (e.g. x67fk6), sorted and paged

params.name: shortId
params.description: Article short id without the /p/ prefix, e.g. x67fk6 (from get-article shortUrlId or a shortUrl like theguardian.com/p/x67fk6)

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Sort order

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, 1-based

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Comments per page

commands.name: get-comment-counts
commands.summary: Get comment counts for one or more articles by short URL (/p/xxxxx), comma-separated

params.name: shortUrls
params.description: Comma-separated short URLs, each like /p/x46an8

notes: The site has no keyword search of its own (its Search link goes to Google). To discover content, use get-front, list-tag-articles, get-tag-feed, list-section-day, list-subjects or list-contributors.
Article URLs look like /{section}/{year}/{month}/{day}/{slug}. Split them into the get-article params; month is a 3-letter lowercase name such as oct.
A tag id such as world/italy maps to section=world and tag=italy. A writer's tag profile/<slug> maps to list-contributor-articles slug=<slug>.
To read comments, take shortUrlId from get-article (e.g. /p/x67fk6) or a shortUrl, and pass the part after /p/ as shortId to list-comments.
Section fronts can redirect to an edition-specific path, e.g. sport -> us/sport, depending on the requester's country.

get-most-read calls api.nextgen.guardianapps.co.uk, a separate Guardian host. One call there worked during exploration and a later one was refused, so it may be unreliable. www.theguardian.com/most-read.json is an alternative that returns HTML plus JSON-LD.
All commands are anonymous public reads; no login is needed.
